title: Mermaid Cove | 30A Escapes
meta_description: BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, private beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.
description_expanded: Description Description BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, private beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.30A ESCAPES presents..."Mermaid Cove," your Gulf-front getaway in Seacrest West! Wake up to the sound of waves, enjoy your morning coffee overlooking the Gulf and take in beautiful water views throughout your stay. This cozy 2-suite townhome offers laid-back luxury with a community pool just a short walk away and easy access to the charm of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Spend your afternoons relaxing on the Gulf-front patio, watching for dolphins or exploring Scenic Highway 30A with the 3 bikes provided. Learn more below...👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf-Front Townhome: Wake up to breathtaking panoramic Gulf views and the relaxing sound of waves.Gulf-Front Patio: Enjoy outdoor dining, morning coffee and beautiful views of the emerald waters.Community Pool: Just a 1-minute walk away, perfect for a refreshing swim or a relaxing afternoon poolside.Convenient Location: Close to Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach for boutique shopping, local restaurants and exploring 30A.3 Bikes Included: Discover the surrounding communities and scenic paths along Highway 30A.Private Parking for 2 Vehicles: Enjoy the convenience of dedicated parking spaces during your stay.Sleeps Up to 6 Guests: Comfortable 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhome with plenty of space to relax and unwind.Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Unbelievable view and very comfortable beds. Hosts were incredibly responsive!" – Melissa G.⭐ "The location is perfect for families. You’re Gulf-front, plus the house is clean and spacious. Highly recommend!" – Courtney H.⭐ "Great stay at Mermaid Cove — perfect location. Would definitely stay again!" – Kate H.*** LIVING AREAS ***Experience comfort and coastal elegance in this beautiful, open-concept living space. Expansive glass doors showcase breathtaking Gulf views and open onto the Gulf-front patio. Unwind on the comfortable, updated furnishings while enjoying the peaceful coastal setting and beautiful views of the water.Spacious open-concept living room featuring plush seating and stunning Gulf viewsDirect access to the private Gulf-front patioContemporary design with stylish coastal furnishings*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Prepare your favorite meals in the modern, fully equipped kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances and generous counter space. The nearby dining table offers a welcoming setting for shared meals, with beautiful Gulf views providing the perfect backdrop.Modern kitchen fully equipped with stainless steel appliances and a wine fridgeSpacious dining area with seating for up to 8 guestsCoffee maker and essential cookware provided*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Start your morning with coffee on the Gulf-front patio or gather for an al fresco dinner overlooking the water. Watch for dolphins playing in the Gulf, enjoy the coastal breeze or settle in for a beautiful sunset. With a nearby community pool and plenty of outdoor space to unwind, Mermaid Cove makes it easy to enjoy the best of coastal living.Gulf-front patio with outdoor dining area for 4Beautiful panoramic Gulf viewsOutdoor shower for added convenienceCommunity pool located just a 1-minute walk away*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Retreat to one of two thoughtfully furnished second-floor bedrooms, each designed for comfort and relaxation. The Primary Suite features beautiful Gulf views and a private balcony, while the bunk room offers a comfortable space for additional guests.1st Floor:Half Bathroom: Conveniently located near the entry2nd Floor:Primary King Suite: King-size bed, flat-screen TV, private Gulf-view balcony with loungers and En-Suite with dual vanities & walk-in showerBunk Room: Twin-over-Full bunk bed with Twin Trundle, flat-screen TV, private balcony and En-Suite with single vanity & shower/tub combo*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located along Scenic Highway 30A in Seacrest West, Mermaid Cove offers a wonderful home base for exploring the surrounding communities. Take advantage of the 3 provided bikes to discover local restaurants, boutique shops and the beautiful architecture of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. The Big Chill is also nearby, offering dining, live entertainment and family-friendly activities.Alys Beach: Beautiful white architecture, local dining and scenic green spacesRosemary Beach: Charming streets, upscale dining, boutique shopping and coffee shopsThe Big Chill: Live entertainment, casual dining and family-friendly activitiesPublix Supermarket: Conveniently located nearby for groceries and everyday essentials*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 3 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection, and coastal charm.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
